Please note: The new Titan TXP range is not compatible with previous non-TXP Titan tools and batteries.

Titan TTB805CHR 18V Li-Ion TXP fast charger delivers efficient power management for keeping cordless trade tools operational on busy job sites. Busy tradespeople requiring constant tool power during intensive daily installations benefit from rapid charging capabilities. Compatible with Titan TXP batteries, this robust 4A charger replenishes 4.0Ah batteries in 70 minutes and 5.0Ah batteries in 80 minutes, minimising downtime during demanding tasks. Plugs directly into standard 240V mains supplies to provide consistent performance across various construction sites and workshops. Batteries sold separately.
